name: Covered Jar (lid)
material: porcelain with blue underglaze decoration and overglaze enamels in red, green, and yellow
summary: In the Ming (1368–1644) and Qing (1644–1911) dynasties, luxury items became more affordable to larger parts of the society, including women, merchants, and literati in non-official positions.
